[LSTO.4.3.4.1] The integration declares whether it persists the
engine's cache, so the runtime honours startup hydration and emits
accurate observability signals. The declaration is a dialect-level
flag:

| Dialect flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `cache_in_process` | Volatile — the engine's cache is not persisted; cold-starts empty on restart |
| `cache_write_through` | Persisted — the integration wires the outbound write-through + startup-hydrate hooks |
